goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann typische Konsumentscheidungen und Biases erklären.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A planned backpack choice is contrasted with a salient sale sign and another product, inviting analysis of framing/salience in consumer choice. No false discount rate, product utility or compulsory purchasing decision is stated; the learner is thoughtful rather than portrayed as inevitably irrational.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px planned backpack, competing products, sale cue and thought question remain distinct; only large labels are used.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the shopper gaze and dotted attention arrow align with the prominent action label, explaining the intended behavioral decision prompt.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The shopper gazes at the offer rather than reading the audience-facing reference card; the card displays a picture without directional writing. The sale sign correctly faces shoppers.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The picture prompts examining a possible influence; it does not establish that every discounted purchase is biased or harmful.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
